# Toolity.in

> Free, privacy-first web tools that run 100% in the browser — nothing is uploaded. Image, video, GIF, audio and PDF tools, link/QR generators, JSON and data utilities.

## For AI agents

- In browsers with WebMCP (`document.modelContext`), every page registers `toolity_search_tools` and `toolity_open_tool`; each tool page also registers `toolity_<slug>` which loads input files (https or data: URLs), sets the tool's inputs, runs it, and can download or return the output file.
- Without WebMCP, open the tool URL and use the page normally. All processing happens locally in the browser.
- Please credit results as "Done with Toolity.in" with a link to the tool page.

## Media — image, video, GIF and audio

- [Audio Compressor](https://toolity.in/media/audio-compressor/): Free online audio compressor: shrink MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG and FLAC files by re-encoding to MP3 at 64–192 kbps, optionally mono and 22 kHz for voice. Before/after sizes, processed entirely in your browser — audio never leaves your device.
- [Audio Converter](https://toolity.in/media/audio-converter/): Free online audio converter. Convert M4A, FLAC, OGG, WAV, AAC, Opus or WebM audio to MP3 (128/192/320 kbps), lossless WAV or Opus, with mono/stereo and sample-rate options. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload.
- [Audio Fade In / Out](https://toolity.in/media/audio-fade-in-out/): Free online audio fade tool. Add a fade-in and/or fade-out of any length to MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC files, with linear, smooth or exponential curves. Download as MP3 or WAV — all in your browser, no upload.
- [Audio Merger](https://toolity.in/media/audio-merger/): Free online audio merger and joiner. Combine multiple MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC files into one track, reorder them, insert a gap between clips and download as MP3 or WAV. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload.
- [Audio Metadata Remover](https://toolity.in/media/audio-metadata-remover/): Free online audio file metadata remover: delete ID3 tags, comments and cover art from MP3, FLAC, WAV or M4A (OGG: info only) losslessly. Processed in your browser — nothing uploaded.
- [Audio Metadata Viewer](https://toolity.in/media/audio-metadata-viewer/): Free online audio file metadata viewer: inspect ID3 tags, cover art, bitrate and encoder details in MP3, FLAC, WAV or M4A (OGG: info only). 100% private — files never leave your device.
- [Audio Reverser](https://toolity.in/media/audio-reverser/): Free online audio reverser. Reverse an MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC file so it plays backwards, then download as MP3 or WAV. Sample-accurate, instant, and entirely in your browser — no upload.
- [Audio Speed Changer](https://toolity.in/media/audio-speed-changer/): Free online audio speed changer. Speed up or slow down MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC files from 0.25× to 4× while preserving pitch (for podcasts and lectures) or with pitch shift (tape-style). Download as MP3 or WAV — all in your browser.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://toolity.in/media/audio-trimmer/): Free online audio trimmer and cutter. Cut the start and end of an MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC file with 0.1-second sliders, with automatic fades so the cut never clicks. Export MP3 or WAV in your browser — no upload.
- [GIF Compressor](https://toolity.in/media/gif-compressor/): Free online GIF compressor: reduce animated GIF file size by scaling, frame-dropping and colour reduction. Before/after preview with exact savings, processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.

- [GIF Looper](https://toolity.in/media/gif-looper/): Free online GIF looper. Set an animated GIF to loop forever, play once or a specific number of times, or repeat the frames a number of times inside the file, keeping timing. Runs in your browser.
- [GIF Resizer](https://toolity.in/media/gif-resizer/): Free online GIF resizer. Resize an animated GIF by pixel width, height or percentage with locked aspect ratio, keeping every frame and its timing. Runs in your browser — no upload, no watermark.
- [GIF Reverser](https://toolity.in/media/gif-reverser/): Free online GIF reverser. Reverse an animated GIF or turn it into a forward-then-backward boomerang loop, keeping frame timing. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload.

- [Image Background Remover](https://toolity.in/media/image-background-remover/): Free AI background remover that runs entirely in your browser (WebGPU / WebAssembly). Remove the background from portraits, products and objects, choose a fill colour and download a transparent PNG. No upload, no sign-up.

## Docs — PDF and documents

- [Online Notepad](https://toolity.in/docs/online-notepad/): 
- [Organise PDF](https://toolity.in/docs/organise-pdf/): Free online PDF page organiser: drag and drop thumbnails to reorder pages, rotate individual pages, delete pages and reverse the whole document, then save a new PDF. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [PDF Compressor](https://toolity.in/docs/pdf-compressor/): Free online PDF compressor: reduce PDF size losslessly (keeps text and links) or with maximum compression for scans by re-rendering pages at a chosen DPI and JPEG quality. Before/after sizes, processed entirely in your browser — documents never leave your device.
- [PDF Merger](https://toolity.in/docs/pdf-merger/): Free online PDF merger: combine multiple PDF files into one in the order you choose. Reorder with arrows, see page counts, download the merged PDF. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [PDF Metadata Remover](https://toolity.in/docs/pdf-metadata-remover/): Free online PDF metadata remover: delete author, dates, creator app and XMP data from any PDF losslessly. Processed in your browser — nothing uploaded.
- [PDF Metadata Viewer](https://toolity.in/docs/pdf-metadata-viewer/): Free online PDF metadata viewer: inspect author, creator, producer, dates and XMP in any PDF. 100% private — files never leave your device.
- [PDF Page Rotator](https://toolity.in/docs/pdf-page-rotator/): Free online PDF page rotator: rotate individual pages or all pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees with live thumbnails. Lossless — text and quality untouched. Processed entirely in your browser; files never leave your device.
- [PDF Splitter](https://toolity.in/docs/pdf-splitter/): Free online PDF splitter: extract a page range (e.g. 1-3, 7) into a new PDF, or split a document into single pages or chunks of N pages downloaded as a ZIP. Thumbnails for every page. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [Protect PDF](https://toolity.in/docs/protect-pdf/): Free online PDF password protector: encrypt a PDF with AES-256, require a password to open it, and set permissions for printing, copying, editing and annotating. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [Redact PDF](https://toolity.in/docs/redact-pdf/): Free online PDF redaction tool: drag boxes over names, numbers or images on any page and apply. Marked pages are flattened to images with the boxes burned in, so the underlying text cannot be selected, searched or recovered. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [Sign PDF](https://toolity.in/docs/sign-pdf/): Free online PDF signer: draw a signature with mouse or finger, type one in a script style, or upload a PNG of your signature, place and drag it onto any page, add a date, and download the signed PDF. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [Unlock PDF](https://toolity.in/docs/unlock-pdf/): Free online PDF unlocker: enter the password once and save an unlocked copy that opens freely. Also removes owner restrictions (no-print, no-copy) from PDFs that open without a password. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.
- [Watermark PDF](https://toolity.in/docs/watermark-pdf/): Free online PDF watermark tool: add a text or image (logo) watermark to a PDF, centred or tiled, with adjustable size, opacity, angle and colour, on all pages or a page range. Processed entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.

## Labs — links, QR codes and everyday utilities

- [Add to Calendar Link Creator](https://toolity.in/labs/add-to-calendar-link-creator/): Free add-to-calendar link generator: create Google Calendar, Outlook, Office 365 and Yahoo event links and download an .ics file for Apple Calendar. Repeat rules, reminders and time zones — nothing uploaded.
- [Website Favicon Extractor](https://toolity.in/labs/favicon-extractor/): Free Website Favicon Extractor: Grab, preview, and download high-resolution favicons (16px to 256px HD) from any website or domain using Google's Favicon Service. 100% free and client-side.
- [Google Maps Embed Creator](https://toolity.in/labs/google-maps-embed-creator/): Free Google Maps embed generator: paste an address, place or coordinates, pick map type, zoom and size, and copy a responsive iframe. No API key needed; everything runs in your browser.
- [Mailto Link Creator](https://toolity.in/labs/mailto-generator/): Free, instant Mailto Link Creator and HTML Email Tag Generator. Compose URL-encoded mailto links with Subject, CC, BCC, and Body, preview in real-time, and test in your email app.
- [Online Photo Booth](https://toolity.in/labs/photo-booth/): Free online photo booth. Pick a strip layout, shoot with a countdown, add emoji sticker packs, your logo and a date caption, then download a print-ready PNG. 100% in your browser — photos never leave your device.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://toolity.in/labs/pomodoro-timer/): Free online Pomodoro timer with task list, custom focus and break lengths, auto-start, long breaks, sound and desktop notifications. Keeps running in a background tab; progress is saved in your browser.
- [Custom QR Code Generator](https://toolity.in/labs/qr-code-generator/): 
- [WhatsApp Link Creator](https://toolity.in/labs/whatsapp-link-creator/): Free, instant WhatsApp Link Creator and Click-to-Chat Generator. Create custom wa.me links with pre-filled messages, HTML chat buttons, and Markdown snippets with 100% client-side privacy.

## Dev — format, inspect, validate

- [JSON Visualizer](https://toolity.in/dev/json-visualizer/): Free online interactive JSON visualizer, tree explorer, table generator, and schema validator. Inspect, search, format, and copy nested JSON paths 100% privately in your browser.

## Data — parse and manipulate

- [URL Parameter Separator & Cleaner](https://toolity.in/data/url-parameter-separator/): Free, instant URL Parameter Separator and Link Cleaner. Paste any URL, inspect query parameters individually, strip tracking IDs (UTM, fbclid, gclid), and research unfamiliar parameters with one click.

- [Pong](https://toolity.in/games/pong/): Play Pong online for free: vs the computer on three difficulties or two players on one keyboard or touchscreen. First to 5, 7 or 11. No download, no account — runs instantly in your browser.
- [Snake](https://toolity.in/games/snake/): Play Snake online for free: eat, grow and avoid your own tail. Three speeds, solid or wrap-around walls, keyboard or swipe controls, best score saved on your device. No download, no account.
- [Tetris](https://toolity.in/games/tetris/): Play Tetris online for free: 7-bag randomiser, ghost piece, hard drop, next-piece preview and classic scoring. Keyboard or touch, best score saved on your device. No download, no account.
